text:
Dana: Hi finance — quick one from this morning's SFO trip. The airport parking gate declined the Redwood virtual card and charged my personal card for exit toll + overnight parking: $48.00. I grabbed a photo of the payment terminal but the printed ticket fell out of my bag and I can't find it. Can I expense this to TR-2026? cc @Liam (manager).

Expense-bot: Hi Dana — policy reminder: missing receipts over $25 require a Lost Receipt Form and a bank or card statement showing the exact charge. For parking specifically, a parking operator folio or gate timestamp screenshot is preferred. Submit at https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt and attach manager approval.

Dana: I have a photo of the exit terminal showing the amount and timestamp (see attached in Concur). Also a screenshot of the bank transaction line showing the $48.00. Submitting now as EXP-8203 under TR-2026. TEMP IMG LINK: https://imgur.com/park-exit-0426.

Liam (Manager): Approved to charge TR-2026 for Dana's airport parking related to client travel. Liam approved 2026-04-26. Please include "Client: SFO visit 2026-04-26" in the Concur comment.

Expense-bot: EXP-8203 received. Status: awaiting finance review. Note: if terminal photo shows both corporate card attempt + personal charge, include both images so we can escalate to cards@redwood to unblock that merchant MCC. Reimbursement ETA 3 business days after approval.

Dana: Uploaded both images: terminal with attempted corp swipe and the successful personal card swipe, plus bank txn. I redacted full PAN numbers.

AP: Finance here — thanks Dana. Two quick asks: 1) please confirm whether the corp virtual card is still active for other merchants (we'll check); 2) please provide a short note confirming you tried corp card first. Once we have the Lost Receipt form + bank txn + manager approval we can clear.

Dana: Confirmed I attempted corp virtual card first — terminal displayed "Card Declined" at 08:12. Short note added to Concur and Lost Receipt form submitted.

AP: Reviewing EXP-8203 now. All required docs present. Approving reimbursement for $48.00 to TR-2026. We'll also open an internal ticket to cards@redwood to investigate the decline at this parking operator.

Expense-bot: EXP-8203 marked Approved and routed for payment. Action created: cards ticket CT-3312 to investigate merchant MCC blocking at SFO parking operator. Payment scheduled: next AP run; allow up to 72 hours to post.

Dana: Thanks — appreciate the quick help. Should I forward the parking vendor contact info to cards@redwood?

AP: If you have vendor name & MCC from the terminal screenshot, please add to CT-3312. That will speed whitelist checks.

Dana: Added vendor name "BayPark SFO" and MCC 7523 to the ticket.

Expense-bot: Payment for EXP-8203 scheduled. Closing thread unless the refund/dispute is needed. If the corp card continues to decline at the merchant, cards team will follow up and may issue a one-off vendor whitelist."
